summary_1line: Bhima defeats Kritavarman’s chariot, Dhritarashtra laments fate, and fierce duels follow including Iravat vs Avanti princes and Ghatotkacha battling Bhagadatta.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima, laughing in fury, shatters Kritavarman’s chariot—slaying the horses and charioteer as arrows rain across the battlefield.
Iravat stands triumphant as the chariot of the Avanti brothers bolts away after its charioteer falls lifeless to the ground.
Ghatotkacha on a blazing chariot fires volleys at Bhagadatta, who towers above on a massive war elephant amid a storm of arrows and broken lances.
